notes.title: We're BACK!
notes.content:
Head Coach Tactics back in full development!!!


That's right, after a 2-year pause, we're back!!  There are quite a few changes and updates to the core concept of the game, (way too many new things to list them all right now) but the biggest ones are:
[olist]
Switch from 8v8 football to full 11v11 football

Added college league!
[/olist]


As a teaser, here is the current in-game menu.  Hopefully this gives you a taste of what's coming.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802312/19b1f267716802b91ac186306131f678f6ba47ea.png"]
